parsed.brief_reason: The patch removes a redundant conditional check that was preventing the loop from breaking when it should. The original code had an unnecessary condition that only allowed breaking when the ancestor was EXPR_RESULT or BLOCK, but the loop should break unconditionally after skipping COMMA nodes. This fixes the general bug where useless code warnings were not being reported in certain contexts.
